note: Adapted from Chhotani's (1997) species description; the original is in English, the alate is recorded as unknown, and selected values from the measurement table are given; distribution records and figure numbers are not included.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule nearly rectangular, about 1.723–1.771 times as long as wide, the anterior lateral corners pointed and of moderate length, antennae 14-segmented and more slender than in other species, the anterior margin of the pronotum weakly notched, the inner margin of the fore tibia with 8–9 spines; worker head capsule nearly circular, antennae 14-segmented, segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 or 4.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow, slightly paler posteriorly and around the fontanelle; antennae pale brown; left mandible nearly black, right mandible red-black; body and legs creamy white. Head very sparsely hairy, body more densely hairy. Body length 5.0–6.0 mm. Head capsule nearly rectangular, about 1.723–1.771 times as long as wide, narrower than in other species; frons inclined about 45°; anterior lateral corners pointed and of moderate length; coronal suture extending from the posterior margin to the middle of the head. Fontanelle transverse, situated about 4/5 of the head length from the posterior margin. Antennae more slender than in other species, 14-segmented; segments 2, 3 and 4 subequal, segment 3 sometimes slightly longer. Labrum asymmetrical, anterior margin deeply concave, lateral margins serrate. Mandibles asymmetrical, slightly shorter than the head; left mandible strongly twisted, with a small incurved beak at the apex; right mandible blade-like, incurved apically, the apical point slender and sharp, the outer and inner margins weakly incurved in the distal half. Postmentum club-shaped; the waist about 1/3 of the maximum width, situated below the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped, anterior margin weakly notched. Inner margin of the fore tibia with 8–9 spines. Measurements: head length with mandibles 3.30–3.50 mm, head length without mandibles 2.00–2.13 mm, maximum head width 1.15–1.20 mm, head height 0.88–0.98 mm, postmentum length 0.98–1.00 mm, pronotal length 0.23–0.25 mm and width 0.55–0.58 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule and postclypeus pale yellow; antennae, legs and thorax creamy white. Head moderately hairy, body more densely hairy. Body length 3.70–4.80 mm. Head capsule nearly circular, wider than long. Fontanelle plate small, oval, depressed, length 0.05–0.075 mm. Antennae 14-segmented, segments 2, 3 and 4 variable; segment 3 generally subequal to segment 4, sometimes longer; segment 2 slightly longer than segment 3 or 4. Postclypeus strongly convex, about half as long as wide. Measurements: head length to the tip of the labrum 1.10–1.15 mm, head length without mandibles 0.75–0.80 mm, maximum head width 0.93–0.95 mm, postclypeal length 0.23–0.25 mm and width 0.45–0.50 mm, pronotal length 0.18–0.25 mm and width 0.40–0.50 mm.
